close_reason: Fixed by PR #109 (eecf16dc): record_read_intent/3 in point_reads.ex registers read conflicts at read-issue time, FDB-aligned, including :not_found results.
description: Point reads that miss storage ({:error, :not_found}) never enter the read conflict set: wrap_storage_get_result falls through the generic error clause and skips Tx.merge_storage_read, so two concurrent txns can read-miss the same key, both write it, and both commit (see PR #108 for the result-normalization approach). Fix aligned with FoundationDB NativeAPI Transaction::get: register the single-key read conflict at read-issue time in get_key_from_storage (unless snapshot), via Tx.add_read_conflict_key, making conflict correctness independent of the storage result shape.

title: Register point-read conflicts on read intent (FDB-aligned)
